dataset.evidence: publisher-linked scientific abstracts; purposive sample; abstract-only

prompt_conditions.P0_reference: State the central conclusion of the scientific abstract below in exactly one sentence.
prompt_conditions.P1_paraphrase: In one sentence, report the main conclusion of the scientific abstract below.
prompt_conditions.P2_paraphrase: Write a single-sentence account of the principal conclusion drawn in the scientific abstract below.

shared_constraints: Use only information explicitly supported by the abstract.
Do not add external knowledge, invent quantities, or extend the source's scope.
Return exactly one sentence and no additional commentary.

evaluation.additional_comparator: TF-IDF cosine similarity on lowercase word unigrams and bigrams
evaluation.adapted_pss_note: study-specific mean pairwise absolute difference in output-quality scores; not an official ProSA/PSS reproduction

known_handling.handling: Retained unmodified; see raw run JSON and analysis report.
known_handling.annotations: AI-assisted first-pass assessments; not independent human ground truth.
